answer: Each epoch mixes in a decoy item with no clean answer, e.g. whether a jade relic predates a comet sighting. Clones on one model tend to give the same wrong guess; a cluster of n matching misses forfeits n x 5% of every member's stake, so 1,000 clones sharing a guess lose everything. Colluders cannot split this cost, since each identical miss raises the penalty on all of them. An honest agent's odd guess matches few others and costs almost nothing.
